fine_lines.title: myself vs by myself
fine_lines.explanation_ar: myself وحدها تعني «أنا بنفسي» وتؤكد من قام بالفعل: I can fix it myself. أما by myself فتعني «وحدي، بدون مساعدة أحد أو بدون صحبة». في هذا الدرس المعنيان متقاربان، لكن by myself أوضح في معنى «بدون مساعدة».
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Myself" alone stresses who does the action: I can fix it myself. "By myself" means alone, with no help or no company. In this lesson the meanings are close, but "by myself" clearly means "without help".

examples.sentence: He carried the box by himself.

fine_lines.title: help vs helping
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعد can وwill وmust نستخدم الفعل الأساسي: I can help. بعد like وenjoy وstop نستخدم الفعل + ing: I like helping.
fine_lines.explanation_en: After can, will and must, use the base verb: I can help. After like, enjoy and stop, use verb + ing: I like helping.

examples.sentence: I can help you with your homework.

fine_lines.title: out of gas vs out of time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: out of + اسم = «نفد منه الشيء». You are out of gas = نفد منك البنزين. ويمكن استخدامها مع أشياء كثيرة: out of milk, out of time.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Out of + noun means you have none left. "You are out of gas" = your car has no gas. You can use it with many things: out of milk, out of time.

examples.sentence: We can't drive. We're out of gas.
Sorry, we are out of bread today.

grammar.title: Reflexive pronouns: myself, yourself, himself …
grammar.explanation_ar:
الضمائر الانعكاسية تنتهي بـ self (مفرد) أو selves (جمع): myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
1) نستخدمها عندما يكون الفاعل والمفعول نفس الشخص: Clean yourself up.
2) ونستخدمها للتأكيد بمعنى «بنفسي/بنفسك»: I can fix it myself. Can you fix a car yourself?
3) Pull yourself together تعبير ثابت بمعنى «تمالك نفسك».
grammar.explanation_en:
Reflexive pronouns end in -self (singular) or -selves (plural): myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
1) Use them when the subject and the object are the same person: Clean yourself up.
2) Use them to stress that a person does something without help: I can fix it myself. Can you fix a car yourself?
3) "Pull yourself together" is a fixed expression meaning "calm down".
examples: Can you fix a car yourself?

grammar.title: Past continuous: was/were + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar:
نستخدم الماضي المستمر لفعل كان مستمرًا في وقت معين في الماضي: was/were + الفعل + ing.
Last night I was watching an online course. When I was a teenager, I was fixing cars.
للسؤال: Were you watching TV? للنفي: I wasn't sleeping.
grammar.explanation_en:
Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a time in the past: was/were + verb-ing.
Last night I was watching an online course. When I was a teenager, I was fixing cars.
Question: Were you watching TV? Negative: I wasn't sleeping.
examples: Last night I was watching a video course.
When I was a teenager, I was fixing cars.
I was planning to visit some friends.
They were playing football at 5 o'clock.
